# 🌱 Mara's Garden

This is a **digital garden** — a slow, public, perpetually-unfinished collection of
notes I keep for myself and occasionally tend in the open. Nothing here is a polished
"blog post." Some notes are barely sprouted; others have been weeded and re-weeded for
years. Each one links to the others, so the right way to read this is to *wander*.

> A garden is not a finished thing. It is a relationship.

## How this place is organized

I sort notes by ripeness rather than topic:

- 🌰 **Seedlings** — fleeting, half-formed. Captured fast, may be wrong.
- 🌿 **Budding** — actively being worked on; I'm fairly confident.
- 🌳 **Evergreen** — tended for a long time; I stand behind these.

See [[On Tending a Digital Garden]] for why I work this way.

## The throughline

If there's one idea connecting all of this, it's that **resilient systems and a
resilient mind are built the same way**: assume failure, embrace what you can't
control, and design for graceful degradation. The clearest expression of that is
[[The Dichotomy of Control]], which I keep finding hiding inside engineering problems
like [[Idempotency Is a Superpower]].

Wander on. Tug any thread.
